desc: Ideation/design decision: decompose p into A*B*C and use occurrence lists with nearest-neighbor (binary search) minimization.
Parse p into segments A, B, C split by the two '*' characters (allow empty segments).
Implement KMP that returns all (including overlapping) occurrence start indices of a nonempty segment in s; call it for each nonempty segment.

Core combination for nonempty B: for each B occurrence use bisect to find latest A with a+lenA <= bs and earliest C with c >= be; handle empty segments by dropping them from the segment list (reduces k).
Handle k==2 (two nonempty literals, e.g. A*C / A*B / B*C) via bisect on ordered pairs, k==1 (single literal -> len or -1), and k==0 ("**" -> 0).
Validate against all four examples (ex1 -> 8, ex2 -> -1, ex3 -> 0, ex4 -> 6) via manual trace; logic confirmed correct.
